summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AirYatra Phase 2 Operator Portal. Backend APIs are working well with 91.7% success rate after fixing aircraft creation ObjectId issue. Frontend operator registration works but has role-based routing issues. Core operator functionality (profile creation, dashboard, fleet management, pilot management) is functional via API but frontend routing needs fixes.
